title: Seven Homicides Across Sinaloa; Cumulative War Toll Reaches 3,963
detail: Noroeste's daily report counts seven intentional homicides on October 6: three in Culiacán (a 21-year-old found wrapped in plastic near La Costerita, a motorist shot near Campo El Diez, and a man killed in colonia Recursos Hidráulicos), three in Mazatlán (Urías and Villas del Sol) and one in Escuinapa. Noroeste tallies 3,963 homicides from Sept 9, 2024 to Oct 6, 2026 and 31 violent deaths so far in October (5.2/day).
